comments.text: Respectfully 6:29 if you expect a snack/drink on a flight from SF to LA you need to rewire your  brain…. DRIVING from SF to LA would warrant at minimum a stop for gas and/or meal and/or bathroom (it’s actually not THAT bad of a drive if you’re a person who doesn’t mind road trips… really just comes down to traffic). But a flight? All what, 37-40 minutes of actual in-air travel? I very much agree with the notion that it shouldn’t be so damned expensive, on that I fully agree. But the notion that the flight attendants (who haven’t seen a DOLLAR of these ticket price increases come their way in the form of a raise… you think that white lady thinks or cares about that? 😅no need to answer, I already know 😊) have to take your drink order, fill said drinks, and deliver said drinks all over the course of maybe 15 minutes is unreasonable for everyone involved. The FAs don’t get paid  enough to be rushing drinks to people; the minute they accidentally spill one, calamity ensues because people are unreasonable and self-centered (“YOU WILL BE REIMBURSING MY DRY CLEANINGGGGGGG!!!!” -type vibes😅). The customers flying run the risk of their drink not making it in time before they begin the approach which means tables up/seats in upright position. It’s a lose-lose proposition for both sides; You want water? Bring it on plane to begin with, that’s a literal travel 101 lesson, as rudimentary a lesson as anything else. You want juice or soda or whatnot? No worries… get it when ya land or before ya board 🤷‍♂️. You won’t be on the flight long enough to care THAT much
